stemMd: Which oxide typically reacts with water to form an alkaline solution?
explanationMd: Sodium oxide is a basic metal oxide. Its reaction with water gives sodium hydroxide: Na₂O + H₂O → 2NaOH. The listed nonmetal oxides are acidic oxides, so they do not provide the alkaline solution requested.

distractorRationale.b: Carbon dioxide forms an acidic aqueous system.
distractorRationale.a: Sulfur dioxide gives an acidic aqueous system.
distractorRationale.c: Sulfur trioxide reacts with water to form sulfuric acid.
distractorRationale.e: This acidic oxide forms nitric acid with water.
